reason: The assessment appropriately captures high frailty and poor prognosis. ECOG 1 underestimates functional decline; rapid decompensation and Grade 4 neutropenia indicate severe vulnerability. Quality of life and comfort-focused care are paramount.
evidences: ECOG performance status is a valid functional assessment tool in older adults.
Grade 4 neutropenia and fatal pneumonia reflect high comorbidity burden and poor resilience.
